messages:
Aisha: Kicking off Atlas Tech onboarding — quick sync to confirm stakeholders, success criteria, and timelines. I propose owners + a 30/60/90 milestone plan. Main risks to flag: SSO/SCIM, data ingestion, and eval pass rates. Can @Priya confirm attendees and any hard constraints? Link to starter doc: https://redwood.ai/onboard/atlas
Priya (Atlas Tech): Thanks Aisha — attendees: Priya (me), Sam (eng), Rhea (security), Mark (infra). Weekdays 10–11am PT generally work. SSO is a must; we need SCIM provisioning. Data will come from S3 (encrypted). Also need a playbook for embeddings, rate limits, and cost estimates. One renewal signal: pricing sensitivity — we need approx cost for 1M tokens/month by month 3.
Tom: I'll own integration + initial evals. Planning 2 x 1hr sessions (integration walkthru, tuning & prompts). Tentative owners: Integration=Tom, Security=Rhea, Infra=Mark, Success=Aisha.
Liam: Product will provide model & quantization recommendations and an evaluation harness. Recommend quality eval in week 2. Also flag: if latency requirement is <200ms we should consider Dedicated capacity.
OnboardBot: :white_check_mark: Onboarding checklist created by Aisha — https://redwood.ai/onboard/checklists/4305001234. Next steps: schedule kickoff meeting; use /availability to share times.
Priya (Atlas Tech): Tue 10am PT works for us. Can you send an agenda? Also do you need our PII redaction rules up front? :wave:
Aisha: Agenda draft: 1) intros & success criteria, 2) infra constraints (SSO/SCIM, KMS), 3) data path & sample delivery, 4) integration plan (Tom), 5) evals & quality gates (Liam), 6) timeline & owners. I'll send calendar invite and pre-kick checklist. Please share PII rules before Tue if possible.
Tom: Posted a quick 30/60/90 draft below:
```
30d: ingest sample data, run baseline prompts, quality >=80% on core intents, internal dev sandbox up
60d: latency <300ms median, cost < $0.02 per 1k tokens (target), scale to 5k q/day, run A/B on prompts
90d: production SLA, runbook + oncall handoff, enablement training for Atlas ops, renewal health check
```
Priya (Atlas Tech): Adding that Legal needs a signed DPA before prod. Mark will own infra provisioning. Rhea needs a list of supported cloud regions for data residency checks. Also request: a short enablement session for our support team (30 min) after week 8.
Aisha: Noted — I'll loop in Legal and attach the DPA template to the thread. Assigning owners in the doc and will share a pre-kick checklist by EOD. Thanks everyone — see you Tue 10am PT. :calendar:
